---
title: "Sjekk av manglende observasjoner i NBA salary-data"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)

project_root <- if (dir.exists("data")) {
  "."
} else if (dir.exists("../data")) {
  ".."
} else {
  stop("Kunne ikke finne prosjektmappen. Kjør dette dokumentet fra prosjektroten eller fra scripts/-mappen.")
}

data_dir <- file.path(project_root, "data")
results_dir <- file.path(project_root, "results")
if (!dir.exists(results_dir)) {
  dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

salary_raw <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "NBA Player Salaries_2000-2025.csv"))
stats_salary_raw <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "NBA Player Stats and Salaries_2000-2025.csv"))

salary <- salary_raw %>%
  rename(Year = Season) %>%
  mutate(
    Player = str_squish(Player),
    Year = as.integer(Year)
  ) %>%
  distinct(Player, Year, .keep_all = TRUE)

stats_salary <- stats_salary_raw %>%
  mutate(
    Player = str_squish(Player),
    Year = as.integer(Year)
  ) %>%
  distinct(Player, Year, .keep_all = TRUE)

missing_in_stats <- salary %>%
  anti_join(stats_salary, by = c("Player", "Year")) %>%
  arrange(Player, Year)

missing_in_salary <- stats_salary %>%
  anti_join(salary, by = c("Player", "Year")) %>%
  arrange(Player, Year)

write_csv(missing_in_stats, file.path(results_dir, "missing_salary_rows.csv"))
write_csv(missing_in_salary, file.path(results_dir, "missing_stats_rows.csv"))
```

## Antall manglende kombinasjoner

```{r}
cat("Antall rader i salary som mangler i stats-filen:", nrow(missing_in_stats), "\n")
cat("Antall rader i stats-filen som mangler i salary-filen:", nrow(missing_in_salary), "\n")
```

## Personer/sesonger som finnes i salary men ikke i stats-filen

```{r}
missing_in_stats %>%
  count(Player, Year, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(20)
```

## Personer/sesonger som finnes i stats-filen men ikke i salary-filen

```{r}
missing_in_salary %>%
  count(Player, Year, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(20)
```

## Eksempelrader

```{r}
missing_in_stats %>% head(10)
```

```{r}
missing_in_salary %>% head(10)
```
